target.title: fix(config): preserve empty env var values in config resolution
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Fixes two related issues where `resolveConfigValue` / `resolveConfigValueUncached` use `||` (boolean OR) instead of `??` (nullish coalescing), causing an explicitly-set empty environment variable to fall through to the literal config key name.

**Bug 1 — resolver fallback semantics**: When `MY_API_KEY=""`, the `||` operator treats empty string as falsy and returns the literal `"MY_API_KEY"` as the API credential. This produces a confusing "invalid API key" error from the provider instead of a clear "not configured" failure.

**Bug 2 — auth status disagreement**: `ModelRegistry.getProviderAuthStatus` uses a plain truthiness check (`if (process.env[key])`) that treats empty env vars the same as absent env vars. After the `??` fix, the runtime resolver returns `""` (treated as missing auth), but the status path still reports `configured: true, source: "models_json_key"`. A custom provider can appear configured in status while runs fail as missing auth.

## Why This Change Was Made
- Replaced `||` with `??` in both `resolveConfigValue` and `resolveConfigValueUncached` so that an explicitly-set empty environment variable is preserved rather than silently reinterpreted as a literal config string.
- Updated `getProviderAuthStatus` to use `in` operator to distinguish "env var set to empty" from "env var not set", and return `configured: false` when the env var is explicitly empty — aligning status with the runtime resolver.

## User Impact
Users who accidentally leave an API key env var set to empty will now get a clear "API key not configured" error (both at runtime and in status checks) instead of a confusing "invalid API key" error from their provider.

## Evidence

### Negative control (pre-fix)
```
BUG: empty env returns key name "EMPTY_KEY" instead of ""
  resolveConfigValue => "EMPTY_KEY" ← BUG!
  resolveConfigValueUncached => "EMPTY_KEY" ← BUG!
```

### vitest (10 tests, all pass)
```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
```

### getProviderAuthStatus alignment
| Scenario | Old status | New status | Runtime (after `??` fix) |
|----------|-----------|-----------|--------------------------|
| Env var = `"sk-real"` | `configured: true, env` | `configured: true, env` ✅ | auth succeeds |
| Env var = `""` | `configured: true, models_json_key` ❌ | `configured: false` ✅ | auth missing |
| Env var absent | `configured: true, models_json_key` | `configured: true, models_json_key` ✅ | literal fallback |
| Shell command `!echo` | `configured: true, models_json_command` | `configured: true, models_json_command` ✅ | command fallback |

### Files changed
- `src/agents/sessions/resolve-config-value.ts`: `||` → `??` (2 chars × 2 sites)
- `src/agents/sessions/model-registry.ts`: `getProviderAuthStatus` empty-env handling
- `src/agents/sessions/resolve-config-value.test.ts`: +87 lines, 10 test cases
